title: Beta Combat
description: Beta-Combat replaces the default critical hit particles, damage indicator hearts and sweep attack animation with custom purple visuals. Lightweight, no textures — just combat effects.
body:
# Beta Combat

Replaces vanilla critical hit particles, damage indicator hearts and sweep attack animations with a clean purple combat aesthetic. Lightweight, vanilla-friendly and PvP focused.

The pack redesigns critical hit particles, damage indicator hearts and sweep attack animations to create a cleaner and more satisfying combat experience while keeping the vanilla feel intact. No texture changes, no unnecessary clutter — just improved combat effects.

## Features
- Custom purple critical hit particles
- Purple damage indicator hearts
- Custom sweep attack animation
- Clean and minimal design
- Vanilla-friendly visuals
- PvP focused aesthetic
- Lightweight and simple

## Included Effects
- Critical Hit Particles
- Damage Indicator Hearts
- Sweep Attack Animation

## Installation
- Download the pack
- Move the ZIP file into your resourcepacks folder
- Enable the pack in Minecraft
- Join a world and enjoy the new combat visuals

## Notes
This pack only changes combat-related particles and visual effects. It does not affect gameplay, damage values or combat mechanics.
